pages.text: The Network Receiver in Refined Storage 2 is used to receive signals from a Network Transmitter with enhanced stability and improved cross-dimensional support. RS2 features better signal reception and more reliable connections.

To use the Network Receiver:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Insert a Network Card to configure the receiving channel$(li)Ensure the channel matches the Network Transmitter's channel$(li)Monitor power usage for optimal performance$(li)Configure security settings if needed

The Network Receiver can be used to extend your network over long distances by receiving signals from a Network Transmitter with improved reliability. This allows you to create separate network segments that can communicate with each other seamlessly. RS2 includes enhanced power efficiency and better chunk loading support.
